about: C4b Keyboard (CTL §12.2, §12.8 K-G1/K-G6; PLAN §1.6, §1.7). The keyboard surface: Steam's VR keyboard overlay as one `thick` cover,
radius 30 (--lgs-r-platter), sitting 10 mm behind the keys (coverMm -10, K-G6: glassd and the scene graph use the same coverDz).
The keys stay Steam's content in the base mosaic at dz 0 (K-G4): no pops, no crops, so every hit lands on Steam's panel at the same x/y.
Cover element: the whole keyboard container (854 x 280) while C4b's echo row is drawn (html.lgs-kb-echo, keys moved down 41 kb px),
else Steam's contents box (the keys, plus the text buffer in buffered mode). 36-keyboard.css drops the CSS platter where this cover is acked.
Reported only while wp.c4b.native is on (surface flag; CTL §12.8: the keyboard ships as T1 until K-G1 to K-G5 pass in a native session),
so V1 can turn wp.c4b (CSS, echo, Enter label) on by default while the native platter waits for its own gate. Test with --flags wp.c4b,wp.c4b.native.
